title: Acoustic Impedance
description: Specific acoustic impedance is a measure of the ability of a medium to transmit sound waves. It expresses the coupling between vibrating particles in the medium and can be calculated as the product of density and velocity of sound.

components.content:
## Acoustic Impedance Calculator

Specific acoustic impedance (Z) is calculated using:

**Z = ρ × c**

Where:
- **Z** = Acoustic impedance (Pa·s/m)
- **ρ** = Density of medium (kg/m³)
- **c** = Velocity of sound in medium (m/s)

Alternatively, acoustic impedance can be expressed as:

**Z = P / v**

Where:
- **P** = Sound pressure (Pa)
- **v** = Particle velocity (m/s)
